comparison.read: plans and nine submitted casual scene blocks
comparison.same_line_note: 투구 경장은 확인한 최신 checkout에 아직 없음

face.reason: 반원형 머리와 낫의 긴 선을 긴 얼굴과 좁은 폭, 또렷한 턱끝, 가는 눈과 얇은 입술로 해석
face.final_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, long length, narrow width; long chin with defined jaw; narrow eyes, medium size, level outer corners, wide-set; angled brows; straight slender bridge nose; thin lips.

casual.scene: An empty natural-history museum reception at evening, presenting a small amber fossil pendant on one open palm; the other hand relaxed beside her waist. Warm display lighting, head through knees and both hands visible.
casual.outfit: Brown halter-neck tailored mini dress with cream side panels, bare shoulders and legs, simple low heels and tiny fossil earrings; original museum-gala event hostess fashion.

casual.scene: A quiet coastal fitness deck at bright morning, stretching one arm across the chest with the other hand gently supporting the forearm. Face turns toward viewer, entire body and both five-finger hands visible, crisp ocean light.
casual.outfit: Gray racerback sports crop top, brown high-waisted fitted cycling shorts and white trainers; bare arms midriff and legs, tiny triangular hair clip.

casual.scene: A private acoustic music room during rainy afternoon, seated upright while polishing an unlettered violin resting horizontally on the table. One hand holds a soft cloth, the other rests separately beside the instrument. Both complete hands visible, cool window light and amber desk lamp.
casual.outfit: Cream sleeveless V-neck cropped knit vest, brown high-waisted wide-leg trousers, small gray pendant; bare arms and midriff, everyday hobby clothing.
